about: Origins agree at a resolution. Read coarsely a claim is wide and three of them meet; read finely each is sharp and the meeting opens into a fork, at the coordinate the coarser scale held together.
One hundred cells, three origins apiece, their centres drawn a fifth of a scale apart, each speaking as sharply as the scale it is read at.
The residual figure stops changing where the reading is sufficient.

cases.name: one hundred cells at six resolutions
